high_level_description: This image captures a serene urban scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, as indicated by the low position of the sun on the right side of the frame. The sky is a mix of soft blues and warm hues, with some scattered clouds adding depth to the backdrop. In the center of the image stands a prominent statue of a person riding a horse. The statue is mounted on a large, rectangular pedestal, which bears inscriptions that are not clearly legible from this distance. The statue itself is silhouetted against the bright sunlight, creating a dramatic contrast.
